decisions.change: Explain the focused repair task before start, preserve the original booking, and leave start, exact approval, and completion to the trusted host.
Use labeled native radio controls for current available Saturday morning slots with Maya Chen and no additional fee. Format times in Pacific time and block choices with unknown required details.

Separate requested draft values from current observed source terms, display checks and conflicts, and offer only explicit Validate source and Restore my choices actions. Do not represent a saved draft as a confirmed booking.
